source.custom: Backgrounds: feat only, no ASI (2026-11-06 ruling).

system.description: Your time in seclusion produced a unique discovery: a forgotten truth, a piece of lost knowledge, or a remarkable find. Work with your GM to define this discovery before play begins. You have advantage on all checks directly related to the subject of your discovery and are treated as proficient in any skill check that involves it, even if you would not normally be.
